items.question: Trong câu "Without a clear product vision, every prioritization decision becomes arbitrary.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a clear product vision, every prioritization decision becomes arbitrary.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
options: tùy tiện, không có cơ sở
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/ (tính từ): tùy tiện, không có cơ sở. "Decisions become arbitrary" = quyết định trở nên tùy tiện, không dựa trên lý do rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/ (adjective): based on whim, not reason. "Decisions become arbitrary" means they are made without a clear reason.

items.question: Trong câu "Without a clear product vision, every prioritization decision becomes arbitrary.", từ "vision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a clear product vision, every prioritization decision becomes arbitrary.", what does "vision" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a picture of the future goal
items.explanation: vision /ˈvɪʒn/ (danh từ): tầm nhìn (định hướng). "Product vision" = tầm nhìn sản phẩm; nghĩa khác của "vision" là thị lực (eyesight).
items.explanationEn: vision /ˈvɪʒn/ (noun): a picture of the future goal. "Product vision" is the long-term picture of a product; "vision" can also mean eyesight.

items.question: Trong câu "When two items both look reasonable, what helps you choose is not who asked more loudly but which one brings the product closer to where it needs to go.", từ "reasonable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When two items both look reasonable, what helps you choose is not who asked more loudly but which one brings the product closer to where it needs to go.", what does "reasonable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reasonable /ˈriːznəbl/ (tính từ): hợp lý. "Look reasonable" = trông có vẻ hợp lý. "Reasonable price" lại là giá phải chăng.
items.explanationEn: reasonable /ˈriːznəbl/ (adjective): sensible, fair. "Look reasonable" means to seem sensible; a "reasonable price" is a fair one.

items.question: Trong câu "When two items both look reasonable, what helps you choose is not who asked more loudly but which one brings the product closer to where it needs to go.", từ "loudly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When two items both look reasonable, what helps you choose is not who asked more loudly but which one brings the product closer to where it needs to go.", what does "loudly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: loudly /ˈlaʊdli/ (trạng từ): to tiếng, ồn ào. "Who asked more loudly" = ai đòi to tiếng hơn, ý nói ưu tiên không nên dựa vào áp lực.
items.explanationEn: loudly /ˈlaʊdli/ (adverb): in a noisy way. "Who asked more loudly" refers to pressure; priority should not depend on it.

items.question: Trong câu "Three signs a team lacks a clear vision", từ "lack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three signs a team lacks a clear vision", what does "lack" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lack /læk/ (động từ): thiếu. "Lack something" = thiếu cái gì (không dùng "lack of" sau động từ). Danh từ: a lack of vision.
items.explanationEn: lack /læk/ (verb): to be without. "Lack something" takes a direct object; the noun form is "a lack of vision".

items.question: Trong câu "The backlog contains many features unrelated to each other.", từ "unrelated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The backlog contains many features unrelated to each other.", what does "unrelated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unrelated /ˌʌnrɪˈleɪtɪd/ (tính từ): không liên quan. "Unrelated to each other" = không liên quan gì đến nhau. Trái nghĩa: related, connected.
items.explanationEn: unrelated /ˌʌnrɪˈleɪtɪd/ (adjective): not connected. "Unrelated to each other" means having no connection. Opposite: related.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple, effective template", từ "template" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple, effective template", what does "template" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a reusable pattern to fill in
items.explanation: template /ˈtempleɪt/ (danh từ): mẫu (điền sẵn). "Vision template" = khung mẫu để điền nội dung tầm nhìn. Đừng nhầm với "temple" (đền).
items.explanationEn: template /ˈtempleɪt/ (noun): a reusable pattern to fill in. A "vision template" is a fill-in pattern. Do not confuse with "temple".

items.question: Trong câu "For chemists and stockroom staff in manufacturing companies,", từ "manufacturing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For chemists and stockroom staff in manufacturing companies,", what does "manufacturing" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: manufacturing /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃərɪŋ/ (danh từ): sản xuất (công nghiệp). "Manufacturing companies" = công ty sản xuất. Động từ: manufacture; danh từ người: manufacturer.
items.explanationEn: manufacturing /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃərɪŋ/ (noun): making goods in factories. "Manufacturing companies" make goods. Verb: manufacture; person/company: manufacturer.

items.question: Trong câu "who lose hours each week finding chemicals and tracking order status,", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "who lose hours each week finding chemicals and tracking order status,", what does "track" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi. "Track order status" = theo dõi trạng thái đơn hàng. Danh từ "track" còn là đường ray, bài hát.
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow the progress of. "Track order status" means to follow its progress; as a noun "track" can be a rail or a song.

items.question: Trong câu "the Chemical Tracking System is a centralised chemical management system", từ "centralised" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the Chemical Tracking System is a centralised chemical management system", what does "centralised" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: centralised /ˈsentrəlaɪzd/ (tính từ): tập trung (một nơi). "Centralised system" = hệ thống tập trung dữ liệu về một nơi. Mỹ: centralized. Trái nghĩa: decentralised.
items.explanationEn: centralised /ˈsentrəlaɪzd/ (adjective): gathered in one place. A "centralised system" keeps everything in one place. US: centralized. Opposite: decentralised.

items.question: Trong câu "unlike the current approach of scattered emails and spreadsheets,", từ "scattered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "unlike the current approach of scattered emails and spreadsheets,", what does "scattered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scattered /ˈskætəd/ (tính từ): rải rác, phân tán. "Scattered emails" = email rải rác khắp nơi, khó tìm. Động từ: scatter.
items.explanationEn: scattered /ˈskætəd/ (adjective): spread over many places. "Scattered emails" are spread around and hard to find. Verb: scatter.

items.question: Trong câu "unlike the current approach of scattered emails and spreadsheets,", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "unlike the current approach of scattered emails and spreadsheets,", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (danh từ): cách tiếp cận. "The current approach" = cách làm hiện tại; động từ "approach" còn nghĩa là tiến lại gần.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (noun): a way of doing something. "The current approach" is the present way of working; the verb can also mean to come closer.

items.question: Trong câu "Four criteria for a good vision", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four criteria for a good vision", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪəriən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số ít: criterion; số nhiều: criteria. Cụm: acceptance criteria (tiêu chí nghiệm thu).
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪəriən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Singular: criterion; plural: criteria. Collocation: acceptance criteria.

items.question: Trong câu "Names a real pain, not a generic wish.", từ "generic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Names a real pain, not a generic wish.", what does "generic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: generic /dʒəˈnerɪk/ (tính từ): chung chung. "A generic wish" = mong muốn chung chung. Trong lập trình, "generic" còn là kiểu tổng quát.
items.explanationEn: generic /dʒəˈnerɪk/ (adjective): general, not specific. "A generic wish" is vague and general. In programming "generics" are type-parameterised code.

items.question: Trong câu "Names a real pain, not a generic wish.", từ "pain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Names a real pain, not a generic wish.", what does "pain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pain /peɪn/ (danh từ): vấn đề nhức nhối. "A real pain" / "pain point" = vấn đề thực sự khiến người dùng khổ sở; nghĩa gốc là cơn đau.
items.explanationEn: pain /peɪn/ (noun): a real problem users face. "A real pain" or "pain point" is a problem that hurts users; literally it is a physical ache.

items.question: Trong câu "Has a differentiator against the current alternative, even when that alternative is doing it by hand.", từ "differentiator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has a differentiator against the current alternative, even when that alternative is doing it by hand.", what does "differentiator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: differentiator /ˌdɪfəˈrenʃieɪtə(r)/ (danh từ): điểm khác biệt. "Core differentiator" = điểm khác biệt cốt lõi. Động từ: differentiate (tạo khác biệt).
items.explanationEn: differentiator /ˌdɪfəˈrenʃieɪtə(r)/ (noun): what sets something apart. A "core differentiator" is what makes a product stand out. Verb: differentiate.

items.question: Trong câu "Has a differentiator against the current alternative, even when that alternative is doing it by hand.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has a differentiator against the current alternative, even when that alternative is doing it by hand.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. "The current alternative" = giải pháp thay thế người dùng đang dùng. Tính từ: alternative (khác, thay thế).
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ (noun): another option available. "The current alternative" is what users rely on today. Adjective: alternative.

items.question: Trong câu "Has a differentiator against the current alternative, even when that alternative is doing it by hand.", từ "by hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Has a differentiator against the current alternative, even when that alternative is doing it by hand.", what does "by hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (cụm từ): bằng tay, thủ công. "Do it by hand" = làm thủ công. Tương tự: manually.
items.explanationEn: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (phrase): manually, without tools. "Do it by hand" means doing it manually.

items.question: Trong câu "If the three answers differ substantially, the vision has not been communicated successfully — however well it was written.", từ "substantially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the three answers differ substantially, the vision has not been communicated successfully — however well it was written.", what does "substantially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: substantially /səbˈstænʃəli/ (trạng từ): đáng kể. "Differ substantially" = khác nhau đáng kể. Tính từ: substantial.
items.explanationEn: substantially /səbˈstænʃəli/ (adverb): to a large degree. "Differ substantially" means to differ a lot. Adjective: substantial.

items.question: Trong câu "If the three answers differ substantially, the vision has not been communicated successfully — however well it was written.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the three answers differ substantially, the vision has not been communicated successfully — however well it was written.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt/ (động từ): truyền đạt. "Communicate a vision" = truyền đạt tầm nhìn đến mọi người; một nghĩa hiếm khác là lây (bệnh).
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt/ (verb): to pass on information. "Communicate a vision" means to get it across; a rarer sense is to pass on a disease.

items.question: Trong câu "If the three answers differ substantially, the vision has not been communicated successfully — however well it was written.", từ "however" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the three answers differ substantially, the vision has not been communicated successfully — however well it was written.", what does "however" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: however /haʊˈevə(r)/ (trạng từ): dù ... đến đâu. "However well it was written" = dù được viết hay đến đâu; khác với "however" đầu câu = tuy nhiên.
items.explanationEn: however /haʊˈevə(r)/ (adverb): no matter how. "However well it was written" means no matter how well; at the start of a sentence "however" means but.

items.question: Trong câu "Reduce mean time from request to receipt from 3 days to under 4 hours, during Q3", từ "receipt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reduce mean time from request to receipt from 3 days to under 4 hours, during Q3", what does "receipt" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (danh từ): việc nhận được. "From request to receipt" = từ lúc yêu cầu đến lúc nhận hàng; nghĩa quen thuộc khác là biên lai.
items.explanationEn: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (noun): the act of receiving. "From request to receipt" means until the item is received; the familiar other sense is a payment slip.

items.question: Trong câu "Discrepancy between system and physical stock below 2 percent", từ "discrepancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discrepancy between system and physical stock below 2 percent", what does "discrepancy" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a difference that should not exist
items.explanation: discrepancy /dɪˈskrepənsi/ (danh từ): sự chênh lệch. "Discrepancy between A and B" = sự chênh lệch giữa hai số liệu lẽ ra phải khớp.
items.explanationEn: discrepancy /dɪˈskrepənsi/ (noun): a difference that should not exist. "Discrepancy between A and B" is a mismatch between figures that should agree.

items.question: Trong câu "Discrepancy between system and physical stock below 2 percent", từ "physical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discrepancy between system and physical stock below 2 percent", what does "physical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: physical /ˈfɪzɪkl/ (tính từ): thực tế, hữu hình. "Physical stock" = hàng tồn kho thực tế trên kệ, so với số liệu trong hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: physical /ˈfɪzɪkl/ (adjective): actually existing, tangible. "Physical stock" is the actual goods on the shelf, compared with the system record.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle: goals must measure a business OUTCOME, not the team's output.", từ "principle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle: goals must measure a business OUTCOME, not the team's output.", what does "principle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principle /ˈprɪnsəpl/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc. "Principle" = nguyên tắc; đừng nhầm với "principal" (hiệu trưởng, tiền gốc) cùng cách đọc.
items.explanationEn: principle /ˈprɪnsəpl/ (noun): a basic rule. "Principle" means a rule; do not confuse it with "principal" (head teacher, capital sum).

items.question: Trong câu "The principle: goals must measure a business OUTCOME, not the team's output.", từ "output" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle: goals must measure a business OUTCOME, not the team's output.", what does "output" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: output /ˈaʊtpʊt/ (danh từ): sản lượng đầu ra. "Output" = khối lượng làm ra (số tính năng); "outcome" = kết quả thực sự tạo ra cho kinh doanh.
items.explanationEn: output /ˈaʊtpʊt/ (noun): the amount of work produced. "Output" is how much is produced; "outcome" is the real effect on the business.

items.question: Trong câu "it is an output metric, and it says nothing about the value created.", từ "metric" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it is an output metric, and it says nothing about the value created.", what does "metric" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: metric /ˈmetrɪk/ (danh từ): chỉ số đo lường. "Output metric" = chỉ số đo đầu ra. Cụm: key metrics, success metrics.
items.explanationEn: metric /ˈmetrɪk/ (noun): a figure used to measure. An "output metric" measures volume of work. Collocations: key metrics, success metrics.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most important difference between a useful roadmap and a harmful one.", từ "harmful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most important difference between a useful roadmap and a harmful one.", what does "harmful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: harmful /ˈhɑːmfl/ (tính từ): có hại. "Harmful" = gây hại. Danh từ: harm; cụm "do harm" = gây hại.
items.explanationEn: harmful /ˈhɑːmfl/ (adjective): causing damage. "Harmful" means causing damage. Noun: harm; phrase: do harm.

items.question: Trong câu "Requires more organizational maturity to accept", từ "maturity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requires more organizational maturity to accept", what does "maturity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the date a loan is due
items.explanation: maturity /məˈtʃʊərəti/ (danh từ): sự trưởng thành. "Organizational maturity" = mức độ trưởng thành của tổ chức; trong tài chính "maturity" là ngày đáo hạn.
items.explanationEn: maturity /məˈtʃʊərəti/ (noun): a developed, grown-up state. "Organizational maturity" is how developed an organization is; in finance it is the due date.

items.question: Trong câu "Why feature roadmaps do harm", từ "do harm" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why feature roadmaps do harm", what does "do harm" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: do harm /duː hɑːm/ (cụm từ): gây hại. "Do harm" = gây hại; "do more harm than good" = hại nhiều hơn lợi.
items.explanationEn: do harm /duː hɑːm/ (phrase): to cause damage. "Do harm" means to cause damage; "do more harm than good" means the damage outweighs the benefit.

items.question: Trong câu "They become commitments in stakeholders' eyes, however clearly you label them intentions.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They become commitments in stakeholders' eyes, however clearly you label them intentions.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person affected by a project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldə(r)/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "Stakeholders" = các bên có quyền lợi hoặc chịu ảnh hưởng từ dự án; khác "shareholder" (cổ đông).
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldə(r)/ (noun): a person affected by a project. "Stakeholders" are everyone with an interest in the project; not the same as "shareholders".

items.question: Trong câu "They become commitments in stakeholders' eyes, however clearly you label them intentions.", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They become commitments in stakeholders' eyes, however clearly you label them intentions.", what does "label" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stick a price tag on
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪbl/ (động từ): gọi là, gắn nhãn. "Label them intentions" = gọi chúng là dự định. Danh từ: a label (nhãn).
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪbl/ (verb): to describe as. "Label them intentions" means to call them intentions. Noun: a label.

items.question: Trong câu "They become commitments in stakeholders' eyes, however clearly you label them intentions.", từ "intention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They become commitments in stakeholders' eyes, however clearly you label them intentions.", what does "intention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intention /ɪnˈtenʃn/ (danh từ): dự định. "Intention" = ý định, chưa phải cam kết. Động từ: intend to.
items.explanationEn: intention /ɪnˈtenʃn/ (noun): something you plan to do. "Intention" is a plan, not a commitment. Verb: intend to.

items.question: Trong câu "They lock in solutions before you learn anything new from users.", từ "lock in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They lock in solutions before you learn anything new from users.", what does "lock in" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to fix so it cannot change
items.explanation: lock in /lɒk ɪn/ (cụm từ): chốt cứng, cố định. "Lock in a solution" = chốt cứng giải pháp quá sớm. Cụm liên quan: vendor lock-in.
items.explanationEn: lock in /lɒk ɪn/ (phrase): to fix so it cannot change. "Lock in a solution" means fixing it too early. Related: vendor lock-in.

items.question: Trong câu "They encourage measuring the wrong thing — the team is judged on delivering features rather than creating value.", từ "encourage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They encourage measuring the wrong thing — the team is judged on delivering features rather than creating value.", what does "encourage" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: encourage /ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒ/ (động từ): khuyến khích. "Encourage doing X" = khuyến khích làm X. Trái nghĩa: discourage.
items.explanationEn: encourage /ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒ/ (verb): to promote, to support. "Encourage doing X" means to make X more likely. Opposite: discourage.

items.question: Trong câu "They encourage measuring the wrong thing — the team is judged on delivering features rather than creating value.", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They encourage measuring the wrong thing — the team is judged on delivering features rather than creating value.", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to try a case in court
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): đánh giá. "Be judged on X" = được đánh giá dựa trên X; nghĩa pháp lý: thẩm phán xét xử.
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to assess, to evaluate. "Be judged on X" means to be evaluated by X; in law a judge tries cases.

items.question: Trong câu "A presentation style that preserves flexibility: three horizons.", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A presentation style that preserves flexibility: three horizons.", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to treat food so it lasts
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ gìn, duy trì. "Preserve flexibility" = giữ lại sự linh hoạt; nghĩa khác là bảo quản thực phẩm.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep, to maintain. "Preserve flexibility" means to keep it; another sense is treating food so it lasts.

items.question: Trong câu "direction is clear but the detail is not settled.", từ "settled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "direction is clear but the detail is not settled.", what does "settled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: settled /ˈsetld/ (tính từ): đã chốt, đã quyết định. "Not settled" = chưa được chốt. "Settle a bill" lại là thanh toán hóa đơn.
items.explanationEn: settled /ˈsetld/ (adjective): decided, agreed. "Not settled" means not yet decided; "settle a bill" means to pay it.

items.question: Trong câu "themes and hypotheses only, nothing committed.", từ "hypothesis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "themes and hypotheses only, nothing committed.", what does "hypothesis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθəsɪs/ (danh từ): giả thuyết. Số ít: hypothesis; số nhiều: hypotheses. Cụm: test a hypothesis (kiểm chứng giả thuyết).
items.explanationEn: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθəsɪs/ (noun): an idea to be tested. Singular: hypothesis; plural: hypotheses. Collocation: test a hypothesis.

items.question: Trong câu "This conveys direction without creating false commitments about distant things.", từ "convey" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This conveys direction without creating false commitments about distant things.", what does "convey" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (động từ): truyền tải. "Convey direction / a message" = truyền tải định hướng / thông điệp. Nghĩa khác: vận chuyển (conveyor belt).
items.explanationEn: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (verb): to communicate. "Convey direction / a message" means to get it across. Another sense: to transport (conveyor belt).

items.question: Trong câu "This conveys direction without creating false commitments about distant things.", từ "false" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This conveys direction without creating false commitments about distant things.", what does "false" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: false /fɔːls/ (tính từ): sai, không thật. "False commitments" = những cam kết không thật, gây hiểu lầm. Trái nghĩa: true, genuine.
items.explanationEn: false /fɔːls/ (adjective): misleading, not real. "False commitments" are misleading promises. Opposite: genuine.

items.question: Trong câu "This conveys direction without creating false commitments about distant things.", từ "distant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This conveys direction without creating false commitments about distant things.", what does "distant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distant /ˈdɪstənt/ (tính từ): xa (về thời gian). "Distant things" = những việc còn xa trong tương lai; "a distant manner" = thái độ xa cách.
items.explanationEn: distant /ˈdɪstənt/ (adjective): far away in time. "Distant things" are far in the future; "a distant manner" means being cold or aloof.

items.question: Trong câu "Four ways to reduce misunderstanding", từ "misunderstanding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four ways to reduce misunderstanding", what does "misunderstanding" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstanding /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu lầm. "Reduce misunderstanding" = giảm hiểu lầm. Động từ: misunderstand.
items.explanationEn: misunderstanding /ˌmɪsʌndəˈstændɪŋ/ (noun): a failure to understand correctly. "Reduce misunderstanding" means fewer wrong interpretations. Verb: misunderstand.

items.question: Trong câu "State the confidence level.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State the confidence level.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ, tuyên bố. "State X" = nêu rõ X. Danh từ "state" = trạng thái hoặc bang (quốc gia).
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State X" means to say it clearly. As a noun "state" is a condition or a region.

items.question: Trong câu "State the confidence level.", từ "confidence level" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State the confidence level.", what does "confidence level" (phrase) mean?
options: mức độ tự tin cá nhân
items.explanation: confidence level /ˈkɒnfɪdəns ˈlevl/ (cụm từ): mức độ chắc chắn. "Confidence level" = mức độ chắc chắn về một kế hoạch; "confidence" còn nghĩa là sự tự tin.
items.explanationEn: confidence level /ˈkɒnfɪdəns ˈlevl/ (phrase): how certain something is. "Confidence level" shows how certain a plan is; "confidence" can also mean self-belief.

items.question: Trong câu "When stakeholders understand why something is prioritized, they argue about goals rather than jostling for list positions.", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When stakeholders understand why something is prioritized, they argue about goals rather than jostling for list positions.", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɒrətaɪz/ (động từ): ưu tiên. "Be prioritized" = được ưu tiên. Danh từ: priority, prioritization. Anh: prioritise.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɒrətaɪz/ (verb): to put first in importance. "Be prioritized" means to be put first. Nouns: priority, prioritization. UK: prioritise.

items.question: Trong câu "When stakeholders understand why something is prioritized, they argue about goals rather than jostling for list positions.", từ "jostle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When stakeholders understand why something is prioritized, they argue about goals rather than jostling for list positions.", what does "jostle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: jostle /ˈdʒɒsl/ (động từ): chen lấn, tranh giành. "Jostle for position" = chen lấn giành vị trí; nghĩa đen là xô đẩy trong đám đông.
items.explanationEn: jostle /ˈdʒɒsl/ (verb): to push to get ahead. "Jostle for position" means to compete to get ahead; literally to push in a crowd.

items.question: Trong câu "Update regularly and state what changed.", từ "regularly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Update regularly and state what changed.", what does "regularly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: regularly /ˈreɡjələli/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên, định kỳ. "Update regularly" = cập nhật định kỳ. Tính từ: regular.
items.explanationEn: regularly /ˈreɡjələli/ (adverb): at repeated intervals. "Update regularly" means at steady intervals. Adjective: regular.

items.question: Trong câu "A stale roadmap loses trust faster than one that changes often.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stale roadmap loses trust faster than one that changes often.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): cũ, lỗi thời. "A stale roadmap" = lộ trình lâu không cập nhật; "stale bread" = bánh mì cũ, khô.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date. "A stale roadmap" has not been updated; "stale bread" is no longer fresh.

items.question: Trong câu "Tie every item to a measurable goal.", từ "tie" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tie every item to a measurable goal.", what does "tie" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: tie /taɪ/ (động từ): gắn với, liên kết. "Tie X to Y" = gắn X với Y; "tie" còn là buộc dây hoặc hòa tỉ số.
items.explanationEn: tie /taɪ/ (verb): to link or connect. "Tie X to Y" means to link them; "tie" can also mean to knot or to draw a match.

items.question: Trong câu "If your organization treats it as a contract, adjust the presentation — fewer specific dates, more explicit confidence levels.", từ "treat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If your organization treats it as a contract, adjust the presentation — fewer specific dates, more explicit confidence levels.", what does "treat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: treat /triːt/ (động từ): coi như, đối xử. "Treat X as Y" = coi X như Y; "treat a patient" = điều trị bệnh nhân.
items.explanationEn: treat /triːt/ (verb): to regard as. "Treat X as Y" means to regard X as Y; "treat a patient" means to give medical care.

items.question: Trong câu "If your organization treats it as a contract, adjust the presentation — fewer specific dates, more explicit confidence levels.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If your organization treats it as a contract, adjust the presentation — fewer specific dates, more explicit confidence levels.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, minh bạch. "Explicit confidence levels" = mức độ chắc chắn được nói rõ. Trái nghĩa: implicit (ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): stated clearly. "Explicit confidence levels" are stated openly. Opposite: implicit.

items.question: Trong câu "If your organization treats it as a contract, adjust the presentation — fewer specific dates, more explicit confidence levels.", từ "contract" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If your organization treats it as a contract, adjust the presentation — fewer specific dates, more explicit confidence levels.", what does "contract" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (danh từ): hợp đồng. Danh từ /ˈkɒntrækt/ = hợp đồng; động từ /kənˈtrækt/ = co lại hoặc ký hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (noun): a legally binding agreement. Noun /ˈkɒntrækt/ is a binding agreement; verb /kənˈtrækt/ means to shrink or to hire under contract.

items.question: Trong câu "The full chain makes every item traceable to its reason for existing", từ "traceable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The full chain makes every item traceable to its reason for existing", what does "traceable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: traceable /ˈtreɪsəbl/ (tính từ): truy vết được. "Traceable to X" = có thể truy ngược về X. Danh từ: traceability (khả năng truy vết).
items.explanationEn: traceable /ˈtreɪsəbl/ (adjective): able to be followed back. "Traceable to X" means you can follow it back to X. Noun: traceability.

items.question: Trong câu "The full chain makes every item traceable to its reason for existing", từ "chain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The full chain makes every item traceable to its reason for existing", what does "chain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi liên kết. "The full chain" = chuỗi liên kết từ tầm nhìn đến tiêu chí nghiệm thu; "a chain of stores" = chuỗi cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (noun): a linked series of steps. "The full chain" links vision down to acceptance criteria; "a chain of stores" is a retail group.

items.question: Trong câu "How do we know this story is done right, including failure cases?", từ "failure case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How do we know this story is done right, including failure cases?", what does "failure case" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a situation where something goes wrong
items.explanation: failure case /ˈfeɪljə keɪs/ (cụm từ): tình huống lỗi. "Failure cases" = các tình huống thất bại/lỗi cần kiểm thử, bên cạnh "happy path".
items.explanationEn: failure case /ˈfeɪljə keɪs/ (phrase): a situation where something goes wrong. "Failure cases" are the error scenarios to check, alongside the happy path.

items.question: Trong câu "A very effective backlog health check: pick five items at random from the top of the backlog and ask which product goal each serves.", từ "health check" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A very effective backlog health check: pick five items at random from the top of the backlog and ask which product goal each serves.", what does "health check" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: health check /helθ tʃek/ (cụm từ): kiểm tra tình trạng. "Backlog health check" = kiểm tra nhanh tình trạng backlog; nghĩa đen là khám sức khỏe.
items.explanationEn: health check /helθ tʃek/ (phrase): a quick review of condition. A "backlog health check" is a quick review of its condition; literally a medical check-up.

items.question: Trong câu "A very effective backlog health check: pick five items at random from the top of the backlog and ask which product goal each serves.", từ "at random" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A very effective backlog health check: pick five items at random from the top of the backlog and ask which product goal each serves.", what does "at random" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at random /ət ˈrændəm/ (cụm từ): ngẫu nhiên. "Pick at random" = chọn ngẫu nhiên. Tính từ: random.
items.explanationEn: at random /ət ˈrændəm/ (phrase): without a pattern. "Pick at random" means choosing without a pattern. Adjective: random.

items.question: Trong câu "If an item traces to no goal, either the goals are incomplete or that item should not be at the top.", từ "trace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If an item traces to no goal, either the goals are incomplete or that item should not be at the top.", what does "trace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (động từ): truy về, bắt nguồn. "Trace to a goal" = truy ngược được về một mục tiêu; "trace a picture" = đồ lại hình.
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (verb): to be linked back to. "Trace to a goal" means it links back to one; "trace a picture" means to copy it by drawing over.

items.question: Trong câu "If an item traces to no goal, either the goals are incomplete or that item should not be at the top.", từ "incomplete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If an item traces to no goal, either the goals are incomplete or that item should not be at the top.", what does "incomplete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incomplete /ˌɪnkəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): chưa đầy đủ. "The goals are incomplete" = bộ mục tiêu còn thiếu. Trái nghĩa: complete.
items.explanationEn: incomplete /ˌɪnkəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): missing some parts. "The goals are incomplete" means some are missing. Opposite: complete.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are valuable findings.", từ "finding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are valuable findings.", what does "finding" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: finding /ˈfaɪndɪŋ/ (danh từ): phát hiện. "Findings" = những điều phát hiện ra sau khi kiểm tra, khảo sát. Cụm: key findings.
items.explanationEn: finding /ˈfaɪndɪŋ/ (noun): a discovery from a check. "Findings" are what a review or study discovers. Collocation: key findings.

items.question: Trong câu "A good vision is specific about the audience, names a real pain, has a differentiator, and is short enough to remember.", từ "audience" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A good vision is specific about the audience, names a real pain, has a differentiator, and is short enough to remember.", what does "audience" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: audience /ˈɔːdiəns/ (danh từ): đối tượng hướng tới. "Target audience" = nhóm người dùng mục tiêu; nghĩa quen thuộc là khán giả.
items.explanationEn: audience /ˈɔːdiəns/ (noun): the intended users. "Target audience" is the group a product is for; the familiar sense is people watching a show.

items.question: Trong câu "An item tracing to no goal means either the goals are incomplete or it does not belong at the top.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An item tracing to no goal means either the goals are incomplete or it does not belong at the top.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be in the right place
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): thuộc về (đúng chỗ). "Not belong at the top" = không đáng nằm ở đầu; "belong to someone" = thuộc sở hữu của ai.
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to be in the right place. "Not belong at the top" means it is in the wrong place; "belong to someone" means it is theirs.

items.question: Trong câu "Outcome roadmaps preserve the flexibility that feature roadmaps give away.", từ "give away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Outcome roadmaps preserve the flexibility that feature roadmaps give away.", what does "give away" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: give away /ɡɪv əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): đánh mất, bỏ đi. "Give away flexibility" = đánh mất sự linh hoạt; "give away a secret" = để lộ bí mật.
items.explanationEn: give away /ɡɪv əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to lose or surrender. "Give away flexibility" means to lose it; "give away a secret" means to reveal it.

items.question: Trong câu "Now / Next / Later balances clarity against premature commitment.", từ "clarity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now / Next / Later balances clarity against premature commitment.", what does "clarity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clarity /ˈklærəti/ (danh từ): sự rõ ràng. "Balance clarity against X" = cân bằng giữa sự rõ ràng và X. Tính từ: clear.
items.explanationEn: clarity /ˈklærəti/ (noun): the quality of being clear. "Balance clarity against X" means weighing clearness against X. Adjective: clear.

items.question: Trong câu "Now / Next / Later balances clarity against premature commitment.", từ "premature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now / Next / Later balances clarity against premature commitment.", what does "premature" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: premature /ˈpremətʃə(r)/ (tính từ): quá sớm, vội vàng. "Premature commitment" = cam kết quá sớm. Cụm quen thuộc trong lập trình: premature optimization.
items.explanationEn: premature /ˈpremətʃə(r)/ (adjective): happening too early. "Premature commitment" is promising too early. Familiar in coding: premature optimization.
